title: PlanModel
description: The single LLM call's structured output. Holds BOTH the gap analysis and the plan. render_plan.py maps this into the repo test-plan template verbatim and adds NOTHING. This full schema is authoritative and is enforced by validate_plan.py; the Groq call uses the restricted twin plan_model.groq.schema.json as response_format.

meta.description: generated_at / source_fetched_at are stamped by render_plan.py, NOT by the model (invariant 5).

out_of_scope.description: Only items the ticket explicitly excludes. If none stated, a single entry: 'Not specified in ticket — see G-N'.

gaps.description: At least one row. If genuinely nothing is missing, one row with classification 'Clear' and question 'No gaps found — confirm with author'.

test_data_env.description: Each value is either content traceable to the ticket, or the literal string 'Not specified in ticket — see G-N'.

references.description: Remote-link titles + URLs and linked issue keys only. No content is fetched from them.

human_review_gate.description: Every TestScenario with basis=='assumption' must be reflected in 'assumed'. validate_plan.py enforces this.

evidence.description: A verbatim quote from IssueContext, OR a string starting 'ABSENT: ' describing what is not stated anywhere. A gap (Missing/Ambiguous) MUST cite one or the other — this is the only way to assert a gap (rule B5).

evidence_ref.description: Where the evidence is: 'AC-2', 'description', 'comment 2026-08-20 by X', 'summary', or 'none' for an ABSENT finding.

question_for_author.description: Empty string only when classification is 'Clear' or 'Not Applicable'.

scenario.description: One observable behaviour / one assertion focus.

maps_to.description: REQUIRED non-empty. Must resolve to an AC id (e.g. 'AC-1') present in IssueContext.acceptance_criteria, or a GapItem id (e.g. 'G-3') present in gaps[]. validate_plan.py rejects unresolved references.

basis.description: 'assumption' => the scenario leans on something not confirmed in the ticket; it must also appear in human_review_gate.assumed.
